title: STORM-Bench: Evaluating Online Video QA under Evolving and Incomplete Evidence

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Reliable online video question answering requires tracking state transitions while selectively abstaining when visual evidence is insufficient.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: To measure reliability, we introduce STORM-BR, a harmonic metric over joint answer-status correctness that exposes abstention failures masked by aggregate accuracy, alongside STORM-BR-ATTR for uncertainty attribution.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Across 14 video LLMs, online accuracy peaks at 60.3\% (mean 51.7\%), whereas STORM-BR ranges from 5.7\% to 35.6\% (mean 18.8\%), driven by pervasive overconfidence on uncertain queries.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: We present STORM-Bench, comprising 5,736 questions across 630 compact, change-dense episodes spanning five egocentric domains (STORM-Real) and two controlled simulation subsets (STORM-Sim) at 1 FPS.
